rationale: Record the shared download retry policy in tools/scripts/download_retry.py, now used by the pinned Skia and V8 fetchers and the wasi-sdk, Skia wasm, pluginval and clap-validator downloads in CI. A transient 408/425/429/5xx, timeout or connection reset is retried over six attempts with 5s to 60s jittered backoff, while 403/404 and every checksum verification still fail at once. The pinned revisions, the assets they resolve to, the bytes written and the unpacked layout are unchanged, so no Skia backend, render surface, design-import, Chromium or packaging authority moves and no captured output changes. The disposition is watch-only.
